question: Should cloud archives intentionally retain issue, pull-request, and comment message content under the proposed remote authorization and retention model?
rationale: The code makes this boundary explicit, but approving remote storage of potentially private review text and coordinating it with a persistent-schema and cross-repository rollout requires human security and product intent.

options.title: Approve with controls and proof
options.body: Retain message content only after access controls, disclosure, retention, artifact inspection, upgrade behavior, and operational recovery are documented and demonstrated.

options.title: Minimize retained content
options.body: Strip message bodies and other sensitive text if remote storage of review content is outside the approved product boundary.

options.title: Pause cloud publication
options.body: Do not ship the cloud-v2 path until the data classification, dependency contracts, and rollout model are agreed across repositories.

recommendation.title: Approve with controls and proof
recommendation.body: Retain message content only after access controls, disclosure, retention, artifact inspection, upgrade behavior, and operational recovery are documented and demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger owns recent release and portable-store behavior and is the strongest available routing candidate for the final security and coordinated-release decision.
